title: 有馬記念の後に・砂利みたいな勝利

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka defeats Daiwa Scarlet in the big race. But for some reason, Vodka isn't as excited as she usually is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Feeling that she can't continue to race the way she has been, Vodka decides that she needs to be more clear about the type of coolness she is truly searching for.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I recommend the Victoria Mile for her next race, where she can sprint full speed ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka decides to spend the time before the race trying to figure out what she really wants to strive for.
